reason: A final pre-training audit found that the prior crash-safe checkpoint amendment still reset Adam moments after an interruption. On a shared GPU that can yield repeatedly, interruption-dependent optimizer resets would be an avoidable confound. The box has 982 GiB free disk, so optimizer state can be preserved exactly without recreating the measured host-RAM spike from Transformers' monolithic serialization.

details: stream each parameter's optimizer state to disk separately so peak host RAM is bounded by one parameter state
atomically expose the completed optimizer-state directory and certify it with model, scheduler, RNG, and trainer global step
restore Adam options and moments with PyTorch-compatible step-tensor placement
reject incomplete or parameter-incompatible optimizer state
resume only from version-2 checkpoints that certify streamed optimizer state
refuse the earlier optimizer-reset checkpoint format
run a fail-closed bank audit before evaluation or training and a final artifact audit after analysis
recompute every frozen evidence score from raw panels
verify exact dataset order, prompt hashes, panel seeds, panel lengths, gold/candidate exclusion, and train-heldout disjointness
recompute held-out correctness and paired-bootstrap statistics
inventory final model artifacts and executed source hashes

checks: Adam moments and hyperparameters round-trip exactly
scheduler position and current learning rate round-trip exactly
the first optimizer update after resume is byte-identical to uninterrupted Adam
the online auditor accepts a valid synthetic bank and rejects candidate contamination

scope: Pre-outcome operational correction made before the online bank finalized and before any online evaluation or gradient update. It restores the originally intended uninterrupted optimization trajectory after voluntary yields; it cannot change the frozen reward construction or any already observed selection outcome.
